title: Evidence retirement counted the 365-day retention from capturedAt, while the evidence-store specification and retentionEndsAt count it from publishedAt, so old evidence published today could be retired at once
resolution: The retention counts from publishedAt in the document, the contract page section 8.2, design decision 5, and the spec delta, with the scenario Old capture published recently; a test that failed before checks retentionEndsAt with different stamps and the descriptions

title: The retention refusal did not require details.retainedUntil or type it, so a refusal without it or with a non-instant value validated
resolution: RetentionRefusal requires details.retainedUntil as an Instant; the scenario Refusal without a retention end and negative tests, which failed before

title: UnknownExecution capped evidence at 64 entries, but withEvidence keeps every entry and repeated uncertain observations add one each, so a valid domain object could fail response validation
resolution: No source bounds the evidence, so the bound is removed (design decision 7, contract page section 8.4); the scenario Long evidence history and a test of 65 entries, which failed before

title: An unknown execution whose evidence held only cancellation-not-applied entries validated, though isUnknownExecution excludes it
resolution: The evidence array requires through contains an entry of another kind (contract page section 8.4); the scenario Only a cancellation that was not applied and a negative test, which failed before

title: Reconciliation pages ordered and resumed by executionId or observationId alone, which are unique only within a task or per worker, so a page boundary between equal identifiers skipped items
resolution: Order and cursors by task then execution identifier and by worker then observation identifier, next as a cursor object, paired after parameters (contract page section 8.4, design decision 7); the scenario Page boundary between equal execution identifiers and tests that failed before

title: credential-ended applied only to a fetch, so a repeated issueRunScmCredential after a revocation of the run's credential had no defined refusal
resolution: credential-ended applies to an issue too, after the remote checks, when a revocation ended the current version (ScmCredentialRefusal, contract page section 8.7, design decision 10); the scenario Issue after revocation; the refusal order is unchanged

title: The scenario Revoked slot expected revoked, but a revocation cancels the attempt (account pool section 8.1) and the earlier check attempt-not-launchable wins in section 7.3's order
resolution: The scenario names a started adopted execution whose attempt the revocation cancelled and expects attempt-not-launchable; the contract page section 8.6 states why

title: The scenario Repeated issue and the contract page promised the same version on a repeat even when a refresh came between
resolution: The promise holds only with no refresh between; the scenario Refresh between two issues, the issueRunScmCredential description, and contract page section 8.7 say a repeat after a refresh returns the refreshed version

title: The evidence-store requirement Evidence reads still required the operator credential and Evidence retention named no retireEvidence, so after the archive two specifications would contradict the per-project reads
resolution: An evidence-store delta modifies Evidence reads (session or operator bearer, project-viewer or above or installation-owner, else 404) and Evidence retention (retireEvidence, its role, 422 with details.retainedUntil), with scenarios; proposal Modified Capabilities names evidence-store

title: readmitTask read the task before the role, so a principal without a role learned which tasks exist from 403 against 404, and design decision 4 called the evidence reads the one exception to the control-plane order
resolution: 9a and 9b check the role on the project named in the path or query first and answer 403; readmitTask follows them with a required projectId query, so a principal without the role gets 403 whether the task exists or not; design decisions 4 and 8, contract page 8.1, 8.2, 8.5; scenario; test

title: The remote re-check requirement and both SCM credential descriptions said the re-check runs first, while the refusal order puts the ownership checks before it, so a literal reading would disclose another project binding
resolution: All three texts say the re-check runs after the ownership checks of launch authorization section 9; scenario Ownership before the binding

title: The first slot credential fetch dropped account pool section 7 condition of a valid launch authorization, so an authorized execution with an expired grant would receive the credential
resolution: An authorized execution with no earlier delivery needs its grant unexpired and not revoked, found from the execution, or gets execution-conflict; otherwise section 7.3 stands in; account pool section 7, design decision 9, page 8.6, requirement Slot credential delivery checks

title: A download reads the record and its content in separate steps, so a retirement in between turned it into a 500 evidence-missing, which the contract did not define
resolution: A download whose record was retired between its two reads answers 404, not 500; downloadEvidence 404 and 500 descriptions, contract page section 8.2, design decision 5, scenario Download during retirement, obligation on item 10

title: retireEvidence removes the record and the content in two transactions, so a failed content removal answered 500 after the record was gone, and a repeat answered 404, leaving the content orphaned forever
resolution: Once the record is removed the retirement answers 204, a failed content removal left to a sweep of unreferenced digests that item 10 adds; 500 and 503 mean the record stays; contract page sections 8.2 and 9, design decision 5, scenario Content removal fails

title: Two concurrent first issueRunScmCredential calls could both see no credential and issue two, leaving one live, unrevoked, untracked secret
resolution: The first issue is serialized per run; the loser returns the winner version and issues nothing; issueRunScmCredential description, contract page sections 8.7 and 9, design decision 10, scenario Concurrent first issues

title: readmitTask answered a repeat after a lost 201 with 409, against product ports section 2 rule 7, which returns the first outcome to a repeat with the same key and input
resolution: Readmission requires readmissionId: the same key and input returns the first 201, the same key with another input 409, and another key at a moved generation 409; scenarios Concurrent re-admissions and Repeated re-admission; a test that failed before

title: The automatic re-admission omitted the task whose launch grant a product writer revoked, which G3 plan row 44 names, readmitTask gave that case as its manual example, and design decision 8 said no source names who starts it
resolution: Contract page section 8.5 and design decision 8 include the revoked-grant case in the automatic re-admission through the same writer; the example is removed from the readmitTask description

title: The order of 404 against the 422 checks of the worker operations was undefined, and an unknown execution or run gave 404 while another worker one gave 422 assignment-not-active, an existence oracle
resolution: An unknown attempt, execution, or run is 422 assignment-not-active after the installation and worker checks, as rejectUnknownAssignment; fetchSlotCredential and issueRunScmCredential lose 404; scenarios Unknown execution and Unknown run; a test that failed before

title: The fetchSlotCredential path implied a globally unique executionId, which is unique only within its task
resolution: The control plane finds the execution by attemptId and executionId together; the description, contract page section 8.6, and design decision 9 say so

title: The wire reason delivery-not-admitted had no counterpart in account pool section 7.3, which names the refusal invalid
resolution: Account pool section 7.3 names the wire reason delivery-not-admitted beside invalid, and SlotCredentialRefusal says section 7.3 names it invalid

title: Nothing kept a remote-userinfo refusal body or record from quoting the stored remote URL with its user information
resolution: ScmCredentialRefusal, contract page section 8.7, design decision 10, and the requirement say a refusal names only the reason and identifiers, never the URL or a secret; the scenario Bound remote with user information checks it

title: A page of 100 unknown executions with unbounded evidence is an unbounded response
resolution: Obligation on item 44 to bound or condense repeated evidence in the domain, contract page section 9 and design decision 7; no schema bound, because no source sets one

title: issueRunScmCredential with an expired but unrevoked current version was undefined
resolution: An expired version answers credential-ended for an issue and a fetch, as a revoked one, because an issue never issues anew; contract page section 8.7, design decision 10, ScmCredentialRefusal, and the requirement

title: The test of a page boundary between equal identifiers checked only shapes, and the ownership reason test checked membership, not the order of launch authorization section 9
resolution: The page test is renamed to what it checks, and the ownership reasons of both refusals equal the first six LAUNCH_REJECTION_REASONS in order

title: The record called the run on 041ef537 the fourth make verify run, but no third run was recorded
resolution: The record names the third run, started after 2f97c01e and terminated during make test with no result when the architect decisions changed the tree

title: The Scope of the self-check omitted UnknownExecutionCursor and UnrecordedProcessCursor, added by the pass 1 fixes
resolution: The Scope lists both cursor schemas

title: The Pass 1 record had no invocation and model confirmation, which worker step 6 requires
resolution: Pass 1 records the Codex invocation and its header: model gpt-6.1-sol, reasoning effort medium, sandbox read-only, and the session

title: Remaining gates omitted the conditional breaking-changes.json entry of design decision 2
resolution: Remaining gates name it: merge dev and run make contract-breaking-changes if declare-contract-breaking-changes lands before the handoff
